Description: Same setup as HollowCubeUnionOffset.json, but with a smaller offset so that the two cavities intersect each other. Cube A spans (0,0,0)..(10,10,10) with a spherical cavity of radius 4 around (5,5,5); cube B is a copy of A moved by (3,3,3), so it spans (3,3,3)..(13,13,13) with its cavity around (8,8,8). The cavity centres are 3*sqrt(3) = 5.196152 apart, clearly less than the sum of the radii (8), so the two spheres overlap in a lens of radius sqrt(16 - 27/4) = 3.041381. Both spheres stay strictly inside their own cube (sphere A spans 1..9, sphere B spans 4..12), so every void is a closed inner shell, never an opening in the outer hull.
Expected:
The union has ONE outer hull and THREE separate cavities, not two and not one:
(1) the part of sphere A outside cube B - three overlapping caps around the corner (3,3,3), bounded by the spherical surface of A and the three cube faces x=3, y=3, z=3; V = 113.730852;
(2) the mirrored part of sphere B outside cube A around the corner (10,10,10); V = 113.730852;
(3) the lens sphere A AND sphere B, which lies entirely inside the common block (3,3,3)..(10,10,10) (its coordinates run from 4.017 to 8.983 in every axis) and is therefore a separate closed void bounded by two spherical caps; V = 43.624902.
The lens is NOT connected to (1) or (2): the material of the other body separates them. Total void = 271.086607.
Volumes: V(sphere) = 256*pi/3 = 268.082573, V(cubeHollowA) = V(cubeHollowB) = 731.917427. V(cube A OR cube B) = 2000 - 343 = 1657, hence V(union) = 1657 - 271.086607 = 1385.913393. V(intersect) = 343 - (2*154.351721 - 43.624902) = 77.921460, where 154.351721 is the volume of one sphere inside the common block. The difference A-B has a total volume of 731.917427 - 77.921460 = 653.995967 and consists of TWO separate solids: the part of cavity B that lies inside A becomes material and is separated from the rest (all its points have coordinates >= 4 and are therefore inside cube B, while the main part only exists where some coordinate is < 3). V = 543.269148 (main part) + 110.726820 (the piece of cavity B inside A, which is 154.351721 minus the lens 43.624902 shared with cavity A). Consistency check: V(union) + V(intersect) = V(A) + V(B) = 1463.834854.
The intersect result is a further stress case: the common block (3,3,3)..(10,10,10) minus the connected blob (sphere A OR sphere B), which breaks through the boundary near the corner (3,3,3) and again near (10,10,10). It should be a single shell with a tunnel running diagonally through it (genus 1), not several pieces.
Status: PASSES (2026-08-12, build 0.2.0.262, after the rule for untouched shell components was added). Keep as a regression guard; unlike HollowCubeUnionOffset.json the cavities intersect each other here, so the operation has to split one void into several shells.
Actual: cubeHollowA = 731.916241, union = 1385.912443 (1 solid), intersect = 77.920991 (1 solid), difference = 2 solids with 543.269115 and 110.727336. All within 6e-6 relative of the exact values.
